title: PolyProPicks Operator Action Event
description: One manually submitted Founder message to an executor surface. Enforced by scripts/control-plane/lib/operator-actions.mjs — a focused dependency-free validator, not a generic JSON Schema engine.

action_id.description: Stable identity used for deduplication. Two events with the same action_id are the same action.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp supplied by the input bundle. Never read from the local clock.

origin.description: Only FOUNDER_MANUAL is counted as an execution operator action. EXECUTOR_INTERNAL is excluded by policy. ARCHITECT feeds architect_corrections only.

mission_id.description: Groups actions into a mission so intermediate_actions_per_mission can be derived.

capture_coverage.description: Per-event coverage. Absent resolves to UNKNOWN.

source_ref.description: Where this event was observed. Required for a COMPLETE coverage claim.

x-invariants: origin EXECUTOR_INTERNAL is never counted as an operator action.
origin ARCHITECT is counted only as architect_corrections and never in the execution operator action total.
Duplicate action_id values collapse to the first occurrence in deterministic order.
A missing capture_coverage resolves to UNKNOWN, never to COMPLETE.
capture_coverage COMPLETE requires a non-empty source_ref.
